observations: body L3: «نِسبَة» (in «نِسبَة قائمة») has no sukun on the sīn.
body L4, L5: the quotation runs from L4 to L5 and ends with three points; «شيْءٌ» has the sukun on the yāʾ only, the hamza with the dammatan cast as one sort.

body L3, L7, L11, L12, L21: the first digits of «٣٨» (L3, L7), of «٣٤–٣٥» (L11) and of «٣٧» (L12, 8.9 points) are 3s with two crests; «٣٤–٣٥» has an en dash (5.5 points); «٢٣» (L12) is a 2 and a 3 (3.1 and 4.9 points); the last digit of «١٣١» (L21) is a 1 rising above the 3, not a 6.

body L6: the Hebrew words are pointed: «קֶצֶב» with a segol under the qof and the tsade, «עֵרֶךְ» with a tsere, a segol and the sheva in the final kaf. The dash at the end of the line is 7.8 points long, shorter than the other em dashes of the page (9.6-10.7 points); transcribed —.
body L7, L8: «الأَضْلَاع» has no vowel sign on the ʿayn. The second word of L8 is «مُنْتَسِبَةٌ».
body L9, L14, L26: ὁ is the δ-shaped sort with the head turned to the right (the rough breathing); the breathing of «Ἀετός» is printed before the capital and is the smooth one, as that of «Οἰστός».
body L11: «وَقْت» has no vowel sign on the tāʾ, «النَّهَار» none on the rāʾ.
body L15: in «مِنْطَقَةُ آلبُرُوجِ» the alif of the article carries a madda (a tilde, 4.3 by 2.3 points); transcribed as printed. «ζωδιακός» is printed without the iota subscript.
body L18: «ὁρᾶσϑαι» and «ϑεωρεῖν» are printed with the theta ϑ.

body L20: «ult.» after «٤١» is printed in full size on the baseline (its l 7.7 points tall). The line number after «٤٣» is a 3 whose terminals touch the middle stroke and the bowl (two narrow closed counters), not an 8.
body L25: «الجَوْزَاء» and «الفَرَس» have no vowel sign on their last letters.
body L27: «اِنْتِهَاءاتٌ» has no vowel sign on the hamza.
body L31: «ونَوْءه» has only the fatḥa on the nūn and the sukun on the wāw.
notes_left L8: ὁ is the δ-shaped sort (the rough breathing).
notes_right L1: «‘Ali» is printed with a dotted i, without the macron.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
